def _enable_debug_log():
    """明示的に呼び出した場合だけAppData配下へデバッグログを出力する。"""
    if any(isinstance(h, logging.FileHandler) for h in _logger.handlers):
        return
    h = logging.FileHandler(str(appdir() / 'debug.log'), encoding='utf-8')
    h.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(funcName)s: %(message)s'))
    _logger.addHandler(h)
    _logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)

def _log_uncaught(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
    try: ERRLOG.write_text(''.join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)), encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in _log_uncaught", exc_info=True)
    try: sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in _log_uncaught", exc_info=True)
sys.excepthook=_log_uncaught
def loadj(p,d):
    try: return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if p.exists() else d
    except Exception: return d
def savej(p,d):
    try:
        text=json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
        # 同一内容の再書き込みだけを省き、保存内容とファイル形式は変更しない。
        if p.exists():
            try:
                if p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==text:return
            except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in savej", exc_info=True)
        p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: _logger.warning("silent exception in savej", exc_info=True)
def btn(t,w=None,bg='white',fg='#111',h=27):
    b=QPushButton(t); b.setFixedHeight(h); b.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
    if w: b.setFixedWidth(w)
    b.setStyleSheet(f'QPushButton{{background:{bg};color:{fg};border:1px solid {BORDER};border-radius:5px;padding:1px 4px;font-weight:600;}}QPushButton:hover{{background:#eef7ee;}}')
    return b
def norm_url(t):
    t=(t or '').strip()
    if not t: return 'about:blank'
    if t.startswith(('http://','https://','file://','about:')): return t
    if re.match(r'^[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}',t): return 'https://'+t
    return 'https://www.google.com/search?q='+quote(t)
def strip_html(s):
    s=s or ''
    s=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?>.*?</\1>',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?is)<[^>]+>',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r'&nbsp;',' ',s); s=re.sub(r'&amp;','&',s); s=re.sub(r'&lt;','<',s); s=re.sub(r'&gt;','>',s)
    return re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',s).strip()
def kata_full(s):
    out=[]; buf=''
    for ch in s or '':
        if '\uff61' <= ch <= '\uff9f': buf+=ch
        else:
            if buf: out.append(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',buf)); buf=''
            out.append(ch)
    if buf: out.append(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',buf))
    return ''.join(out)
def lines(t): return [x.strip() for x in strip_html(t).splitlines() if x.strip()]
def after(t,k):
    ls=lines(t)
    for i,x in enumerate(ls):
        if x.lower()==k.lower() and i+1<len(ls): return ls[i+1]
    # key:value variants
    pat=r'(?im)^\s*'+re.escape(k)+r'\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$'
    m=re.search(pat,strip_html(t))
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
def regex_first(t, patterns):
    st=strip_html(t)
    for pat in patterns:
        m=re.search(pat,st,re.I|re.M)
        if m: return m.group(1).strip()
    return ''
def tag_of(t):
    v=regex_first(t,[r'[￭■\-\*\s]*(?:Tag|TAG|タグ|サービスタグ|Sタグ|Service\s*Tag)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*([A-Z0-9]{5,10})\b'])
    if v: return v.upper()
    a=after(t,'Asset')
    return a.upper() if re.match(r'^[A-Z0-9]{5,10}$',a or '') and re.search(r'\d',a) else ''
def case_of(t):
    v=regex_first(t,[r'[￭■\-\*\s]*(?:CASE|Case|ケース)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(\d{6,})\b'])
    if v: return v
    m=re.search(r'(?im)^\s*Case\s*$\s*(\d{6,})\b',strip_html(t))
    if m: return m.group(1)
    v=after(t,'Case') or after(t,'Case Number')
    return v if re.search(r'\d',v or '') else ''
def product_of(t):
    return (regex_first(t,[r'(?:機種名|機種|model|Model)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$']) or after(t,'Product Description')).strip()
def phenomenon_of(t):
    return (regex_first(t,[r'(?:現象|症状)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$']) or after(t,'Case Description')).strip()
def account_of(t): return after(t,'Account Name')
def merge_info(primary, secondary=''):
    p={'tag':tag_of(primary),'case':case_of(primary),'product':product_of(primary),'phenomenon':phenomenon_of(primary),'account':account_of(primary)}
    s={'tag':tag_of(secondary),'case':case_of(secondary),'product':product_of(secondary),'phenomenon':phenomenon_of(secondary),'account':account_of(secondary)}
    return {k:(p.get(k) or s.get(k) or '') for k in p}
def mask(t):
    t=strip_html(t)
    for p,r in [(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}','[EMAIL]'),(r'https?://[^\s]+','[URL]')]: t=re.sub(p,r,t,flags=re.I)
    return t
def memo_input_info(text):
    text=strip_html(text or '').replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\r','\n')
    lines=[x.strip() for x in text.split('\n')]
    labels={'tag':('Service Tag','ServiceTag','サービスタグ','S Tag','Sタグ','TAG','タグ','Asset'),'case':('Case Number','CASE','Case','ケース'),'product':('Product Description','機種名','機種','Model'),'phenomenon':('Case Description','現象','症状','障害内容'),'account':('Account Name','顧客名','お客様名','Customer Name')}
    all_labels={x.lower() for v in labels.values() for x in v}; found={k:'' for k in labels}
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line: continue
        low=line.lower()
        for key,names in labels.items():
            for label in names:
                ll=label.lower(); value=''
                if low==ll:
                    j=i+1
                    while j<len(lines) and not lines[j]: j+=1
                    if j<len(lines) and lines[j].lower() not in all_labels:value=lines[j]
                elif any(low.startswith(ll+s) for s in (':','：','#','＃')):value=line[len(label):].lstrip(' \t:：#＃')
                if value and not found[key]:
                    candidate=value.strip()
                    if key=='case' and not re.search(r'\d{6,}',candidate):continue
                    if key=='tag':
                        compact=''.join(candidate.split()).upper()
                        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z0-9]{5,10}',compact) or not re.search(r'\d',compact):continue
                    found[key]=candidate
    if not found['tag']:
        m=re.search(r'(?<![A-Z0-9])([A-Z0-9]{7})(?![A-Z0-9])',text,re.I)
        if m:found['tag']=m.group(1)
    found['tag']=''.join(found['tag'].split()).upper()
    if found['case']:
        m=re.search(r'\d{6,}',found['case']);found['case']=m.group(0) if m else ''
    if not found['case']:
        m=re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{6,})(?!\d)',text)
        if m:found['case']=m.group(1)
    return found

def subject(i): return kata_full('[CTE ESC]TAG#%s/CASE#%s/機種:%s/現象:%s/顧客名:%s様'%((i.get('tag') or '未検出'),(i.get('case') or '未検出'),(i.get('product') or '未検出'),(i.get('phenomenon') or '未検出'),(i.get('account') or '未検出')))
def memo_min(i): return '\n'.join(['■TAG#%s'%(i.get('tag') or '未検出'),'■CASE#%s'%(i.get('case') or '未検出'),'■機種：%s'%(i.get('product') or '未検出')])
def tag_display_text(n):
    if not isinstance(n,dict): return ''
    tag=(n.get('tag') or '').strip()
    if tag: return tag
    info=merge_info(n.get('raw',''),n.get('content',''))
    return (info.get('tag') or '').strip()

def normalize_tag_text(raw):
    raw=strip_html(raw or '').strip()
    v=tag_of(raw)
    if v: return v
    # 直接TAGだけを入力した場合は保持。それ以外の文章はTAG欄へ表示しない。
    return raw.upper() if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{5,10}', raw) and re.search(r'\d', raw) else ''
def tag_color_index(n):
    try:
        return n.get('fixed_index',n.get('color',0)) if is_fixed(n) else n.get('color',0)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def lkb(t):
    m=re.search(r'(?i)LKB[#\s-]*(\d+)',strip_html(t))
    return 'LKB#'+m.group(1) if m else ''
def rec_prompt(raw,i):
    return '\n'.join(['以下のメモ内容からRECエスカレーション用の内容だけを作成してください。','下記形式を必ず維持してください。余計な見出しや「REC Chat用」は不要です。','個人情報は含めないでください。','','■TAG#%s'%(i.get('tag') or '未検出'),'■CASE#%s'%(i.get('case') or '未検出'),'■機種：%s'%(i.get('product') or '未検出'),'■Ask:RECへのエスカレーション内容要約(RECがどうSupportできるか伺い)','■KBキーワード:%s'%lkb(raw),'■DTC Keywords:','■Summary:問題についての明確な説明','','■理由/背景：あれば（お客様背景や●台中●台の問題などAIが自動入力）','■OS情報：あれば（できる限り詳細を記載）','■いつから：あれば','■頻度：あれば','■その他情報：あれば（ログ解析結果やエスカレーションで必要な内容）','','--- メモ内容 ---',mask(raw)])
def build_prompt(name,raw,prompts,tag):
    template=prompts.get(name,PROMPTS.get(name,''));memo=mask(raw);limit=180000
    if len(template)+len(memo)>limit:memo=memo[:max(0,limit-len(template))]+'\n\n[メモ内容が長いため送信上限で省略]'
    return template+'\n\n--- 現在のメモ情報 ---\n'+memo
class PlainTextEdit(QTextEdit):
    def insertFromMimeData(self, source):
        self.insertPlainText(source.text())

_KNOWLEDGE_B64=''
_DELL_NS=None; _DELL_CLASS=None
def load_embedded_dell_sites_tab():
    global _DELL_NS,_DELL_CLASS
    if _DELL_CLASS is not None: return _DELL_CLASS
    ns={'__name__':'embedded_knowledge_dell_sites'}
    exec(compile(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_KNOWLEDGE_B64)).decode('utf-8'),'embedded_knowledge.txt','exec'),ns)
    _DELL_NS=ns; _DELL_CLASS=ns.get('DellSitesTab'); return _DELL_CLASS
class FloatingOpenButton(QPushButton):
    def __init__(self,parent,overlay):
        super().__init__('DELL開く',parent); self.overlay=overlay
        self.setFixedSize(86,28)
        self.setStyleSheet('QPushButton{background:#dbeafe;border:1px solid #60a5fa;border-radius:7px;font-weight:700;}QPushButton:hover{background:#bfdbfe;}')
        self.clicked.connect(self.overlay.restore_overlay)
    def place(self):
        p=self.parentWidget().rect(); self.move(max(0,p.width()-95),28); self.raise_()
class FloatingDellOverlay(QFrame):
    HANDLE_W=6
    def __init__(self,parent,settings):
        super().__init__(parent); self.settings=settings; self.resizing=False; self.start_x=0; self.start_w=0
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=False
        self.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame); self.setStyleSheet('QFrame{background:white;border-left:1px solid #cbd5e1;}')
        lay=QVBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(self.HANDLE_W,0,0,0); lay.setSpacing(0)
        self.head=QWidget(); self.head.setStyleSheet('background:#f8fafc;border-bottom:1px solid #cbd5e1;')
        hl=QHBoxLayout(self.head); hl.setContentsMargins(6,2,6,2)
        self.title=QLabel('DELLサイトなど'); self.minbtn=QPushButton('－'); self.minbtn.setFixedSize(28,22)
        hl.addWidget(self.title); hl.addStretch(); hl.addWidget(self.minbtn); lay.addWidget(self.head,0)
        try: self.dell=load_embedded_dell_sites_tab()(self)
        except Exception as e: self.dell=QLabel('DellSitesTab読込エラー: '+str(e)); self.dell.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.dell,1)
        self.handle=QFrame(self); self.handle.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.SizeHorCursor); self.handle.setStyleSheet('background:#9ca3af; border-right:1px solid #64748b;')
        self.handle.mousePressEvent=self.handle_press; self.handle.mouseMoveEvent=self.handle_move; self.handle.mouseReleaseEvent=self.handle_release
        self.close_btn=QPushButton('閉じる'); self.close_btn.setFixedSize(48,24)
        self.close_btn.setStyleSheet('QPushButton{background:#fee2e2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:5px;font-weight:600;}')
        self.close_btn.clicked.connect(self.minimize); self.minbtn.clicked.connect(self.minimize)
        self.open_btn=FloatingOpenButton(parent,self); self.open_btn.hide()
        if 'dell_overlay_width' not in self.settings: self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=760
        QTimer.singleShot(0,self.setup_close_button); QTimer.singleShot(0,self.apply_dock_geometry)
    def setup_close_button(self):
        try:
            b=getattr(self.dell,'back_button',None)
            if b and b.parentWidget() and b.parentWidget().layout(): b.parentWidget().layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
            else: self.close_btn.setParent(self.head); self.head.layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
        except Exception: self.close_btn.setParent(self.head); self.head.layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
    def apply_dock_geometry(self):
        p=self.parentWidget().rect(); self.open_btn.place()
        if self.settings.get('dell_overlay_minimized'): return
        w=max(420,min(int(self.settings.get('dell_overlay_width',760)),p.width()-80))
        self.setGeometry(p.width()-w,0,w,p.height()); self.handle.setGeometry(0,0,self.HANDLE_W,self.height()); self.handle.raise_(); self.raise_()
    def handle_press(self,e):
        if e.button()==Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton: self.resizing=True; self.start_x=e.globalPosition().toPoint().x(); self.start_w=self.width(); e.accept()
    def handle_move(self,e):
        if self.resizing:
            dx=self.start_x-e.globalPosition().toPoint().x(); p=self.parentWidget().rect(); w=max(420,min(self.start_w+dx,p.width()-80)); self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=w; self.apply_dock_geometry(); e.accept()
    def handle_release(self,e): self.resizing=False
    def minimize(self):
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=True; self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=max(self.width(),420); self.hide(); self.open_btn.show(); self.open_btn.place()
    def restore_overlay(self):
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=False; self.open_btn.hide(); self.show(); self.apply_dock_geometry()
    def set_tag_for_group(self,idx,tag):
        try:
            if hasattr(self.dell,'tag_boxes') and 0<=idx<len(self.dell.tag_boxes):
                box=self.dell.tag_boxes[idx]
                if box.text()!=tag: box.setText(tag or '')
                # tag only sync: do not auto-open
        except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in FloatingDellOverlay.set_tag_for_group", exc_info=True)

class AskColorTabBar(QTabBar):
    COLORS=TAG_TAB_COLORS
    SELECT=['#93c5fd','#fde68a','#f9a8d4','#c4b5fd']
    def tabSizeHint(self,i):
        s=super().tabSizeHint(i); s.setWidth(max(74,s.width()+12)); s.setHeight(max(30,s.height()+4)); return s
    def paintEvent(self,e):
        p=QPainter(self); p.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        for i in range(self.count()):
            r=self.tabRect(i).adjusted(2,4,-2,-2)
            p.setPen(QColor('#94a3b8'))
            base = (self.COLORS[i] if i < 4 else '#ffffff')
            sel = (self.SELECT[i] if i < 4 else SELECTED_BLUE)
            p.setBrush(QColor(sel if i==self.currentIndex() else base))
            p.drawRoundedRect(r,7,7)
            p.setPen(QColor('#ffffff' if i==self.currentIndex() and i>=4 else '#111827'))
            p.drawText(r,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,self.tabText(i))

        if WEB:
            self.prof=QWebEngineProfile('AskProfile',self); self.prof.setPersistentStoragePath(str(appdir()/'AskProfile')); self.prof.setCachePath(str(appdir()/'AskCache')); self.prof.setPersistentCookiesPolicy(QWebEngineProfile.PersistentCookiesPolicy.ForcePersistentCookies); self.prof.setHttpUserAgent(UA)
        self.reload.clicked.connect(self.reload_current); self.clear.clicked.connect(self.clear_input)
    def slot(self,n):
        try: return max(0,min(3,int(n.get('fixed_index',0))))
        except Exception: return 0
    def title(self,n): return FIXED_TAG_TITLES[self.slot(n)]
    def ensure(self,n):
        i=self.slot(n); nid=n['id']
        if self.slot_id[i]==nid and self.slot_view[i] is not None:
            v=self.slot_view[i]
            idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
            if idx>=0: self.tabs.setTabText(idx,self.title(n))
            return v
        old=self.slot_view[i]
        if old is not None:
            old_idx=self.tabs.indexOf(old)
            if old_idx>=0: self.tabs.removeTab(old_idx)
            self.map.pop(self.slot_id[i],None)
            old.deleteLater()
        if WEB:
            v=QWebEngineView(); v.setPage(Page(self.prof,None,v)); v.setZoomFactor(.72); v.setUrl(QUrl(ASK))
        else: v=QLabel('WebEngineなし')
        self.slot_id[i]=nid; self.slot_view[i]=v; self.map[nid]=v
        self.tabs.insertTab(i,v,self.title(n))
        return v
    def switch(self,n):
        v=self.ensure(n); idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
        if idx>=0: self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(idx)
    def reload_current(self):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView): v.reload()
    def clear_input(self):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView): v.page().runJavaScript("document.querySelectorAll('textarea,div[contenteditable=\\\"true\\\"],[role=\\\"textbox\\\"],input[type=\\\"text\\\"]').forEach(e=>{if(['TEXTAREA','INPUT'].includes(e.tagName))e.value='';else e.textContent='';e.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));});")
    def delete_tab(self,nid):
        if nid not in self.map: return
        v=self.map.pop(nid)
        idx_slot=next((i for i,x in enumerate(self.slot_id) if x==nid),-1)
        if idx_slot>=0: self.slot_id[idx_slot]=None; self.slot_view[idx_slot]=None
        idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
        if idx>=0: self.tabs.removeTab(idx)
        v.deleteLater()
    def set_prompt(self,t): self.last=t; QApplication.clipboard().setText(t)
    def send(self,enter=True):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if not (WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView)): return
        text=self.last or QApplication.clipboard().text(); QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        ent="setTimeout(()=>{el.focus();el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,which:13,bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,which:13,bubbles:true}));},300);" if enter else ''
        js="(()=>{const text="+json.dumps(text)+";const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('textarea,div[contenteditable=\\\"true\\\"],[role=\\\"textbox\\\"],input[type=\\\"text\\\"]')];const el=n[0];if(!el)return false;el.focus();if(['TEXTAREA','INPUT'].includes(el.tagName)){el.value=text;el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,data:text}));}else{el.textContent=text;el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,data:text}));}"+ent+"return true;})();"
        v.page().runJavaScript(js)

    def new(self): return {'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'title':'メモ%d'%(len(self.notes)+1),'content':'','raw':'','tag':'','color':len(self.notes)%len(COLORS)}
    def current_prompt(self):
        it=self.plist.currentItem() or self.plist.item(0); return ((it.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) if it else '') or '🔎 汎用分析')
    def load(self):
        d=loadj(MEMO,{}); self.notes=d.get('notes',[]) if isinstance(d,dict) else []
        if not self.notes: self.notes=[self.new()]
        for i,n in enumerate(self.notes): n.setdefault('id',str(uuid.uuid4())); n.setdefault('title','メモ%d'%(i+1)); n.setdefault('content',''); n.setdefault('raw',''); n.setdefault('tag',tag_of(n.get('raw',''))); n.setdefault('color',i%len(COLORS))
        self.idx=max(0,min(d.get('idx',0) if isinstance(d,dict) else 0,len(self.notes)-1)); self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); [self.ask.ensure(n) for n in self.notes]
    def save(self): self.sync(); savej(MEMO,{'notes':self.notes,'idx':self.idx}); self.s['prompt_order']=[self.plist.item(i).text() for i in range(self.plist.count())]; self.s['split_sizes']=self.split.sizes()
    def refresh(self):
        self.list.blockSignals(True); self.list.clear()
        for n in self.notes:
            it=QListWidgetItem(); it.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole,n['id']); it.setSizeHint(QSize(132,58)); self.list.addItem(it); w=NoteItem(n); w.raw_changed.connect(lambda raw,nid=n['id']:self.related_changed(nid,raw)); w.delete.connect(lambda nid=n['id']:self.delete(nid)); self.list.setItemWidget(it,w)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        try:
            for _si,_sn in enumerate(self.notes[:4]):
                self.sync_tag_to_dell(_si,_sn.get('tag',''))
        except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in App.refresh", exc_info=True)
    def sync(self):
        if 0<=self.idx<len(self.notes): self.notes[self.idx]['content']=strip_html(self.edit.toPlainText())
    def cur_info(self):
        if not (0<=self.idx<len(self.notes)): return merge_info('','')
        n=self.notes[self.idx]; return merge_info(n.get('raw',''),'')
    def update_outputs(self):
        i=self.cur_info(); self.sub.setText(subject(i)); self.mx.setPlainText(memo_min(i))
    def apply(self): self.edit.blockSignals(True); self.edit.setPlainText(strip_html(self.notes[self.idx].get('content',''))); self.edit.blockSignals(False); self.ask.switch(self.notes[self.idx]); self.update_outputs()
    def related_changed(self,nid,raw):
        for i,n in enumerate(self.notes):
            if n['id']==nid:
                cleaned=strip_html(raw)
                n['raw']=cleaned
                info=merge_info(cleaned,n.get('content',''))
                if info.get('tag'): n['tag']=info.get('tag','')
                n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i] if i<4 else (info.get('tag') or n.get('title') or 'メモ')
                try: self.sync_tag_to_dell(i,n.get('tag',''))
                except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in App.related_changed", exc_info=True)
                if i==self.idx:
                    try: self.apply()
                    except Exception: self.update_outputs()
                break
        self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.save()
    def change(self,row): self.sync(); self.idx=row if 0<=row<len(self.notes) else self.idx; self.apply(); self.save()
    def text_change(self): self.sync(); self.update_outputs(); self.save()
    def add_note(self):
        self.sync(); n=self.new(); self.notes.append(n); self.idx=len(self.notes)-1; self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.edit.clear(); self.apply(); self.ask.ensure(n); self.save()
    def delete(self,nid):
        if len(self.notes)==1: self.notes[0].update({'title':'メモ1','content':'','raw':'','tag':''}); self.idx=0
        else: self.notes=[n for n in self.notes if n['id']!=nid]; self.ask.delete_tab(nid); self.idx=max(0,min(self.idx,len(self.notes)-1))
        self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); self.save()
    def to_ask(self,enter): self.sync(); n=self.notes[self.idx]; self.ask.switch(n); source=(n.get('raw','')+'\n'+self.edit.toPlainText()).strip(); self.ask.set_prompt(build_prompt(self.current_prompt(),source,self.prompts,n.get('tag',''))); self.ask.send(enter)
    def save_state(self,s): self.save(); g=self.geometry(); s['app_geo']=[g.x(),g.y(),g.width(),g.height()]

def configure_web_profile(prof, name='SharedSSOProfile'):
    if not (WEB and prof): return prof
    try:
        base=appdir()/name
        prof.setPersistentStoragePath(str(base))
        prof.setCachePath(str(appdir()/(name+'Cache')))
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in configure_web_profile", exc_info=True)
    try: prof.setPersistentCookiesPolicy(QWebEngineProfile.PersistentCookiesPolicy.ForcePersistentCookies)
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in configure_web_profile", exc_info=True)
    try:
        current_ua=(prof.httpUserAgent() or '').strip(); current_ua=re.sub(r'\s+QtWebEngine/[^\s]+','',current_ua).strip()
        if current_ua: prof.setHttpUserAgent(current_ua)
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in configure_web_profile", exc_info=True)
    try: prof.setHttpAcceptLanguage('ja-JP,ja;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7')
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in configure_web_profile", exc_info=True)
    return prof
def is_fixed(n): return isinstance(n.get('fixed_index'),int) and 0<=n.get('fixed_index')<=3
def ntitle(n):
    t=(n.get('tag') or '').strip()
    if t: return t[:18]
    return FIXED_TAG_TITLES[n['fixed_index']] if is_fixed(n) else (n.get('title') or 'メモ')[:18]
def fixed_note(i, old=None):
    old=old or {}; raw=str(old.get('raw','') or '')
    return {'id':str(old.get('id') or uuid.uuid4()),'title':FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i],'content':str(old.get('content','') or ''),'raw':raw,'tag':tag_of(raw),'color':i,'fixed_index':i}
def extra_note(notes):
    names=[n.get('title','') for n in notes]; i=1
    while f'メモ{i}' in names: i+=1
    return {'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'title':f'メモ{i}','content':'','raw':'','tag':'','color':len(notes)%len(COLORS)}

def cleanup_req_path(): return appdir()/'restart_cleanup_request.json'
def req_cleanup(mode):
    try: cleanup_req_path().write_text(json.dumps({'mode':mode},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in req_cleanup", exc_info=True)
def perform_cleanup():
    try:
        p=cleanup_req_path()
        if not p.exists(): return
        m=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')).get('mode')
        import shutil
        targets=[]
        if m in ('dell_cache','dell_sso'): targets.append(appdir()/'DellSitesCache')
        if m=='dell_sso': targets.append(appdir()/'DellSitesProfile')
        for t in targets:
            if t.exists(): shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in perform_cleanup", exc_info=True)
def app_restart():
    try: QProcess.startDetached(sys.executable, sys.argv); QApplication.quit()
    except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in app_restart", exc_info=True)

class Page(QWebEnginePage if WEB else object):

class AskTab(QWidget):
    def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):
        super().__init__(); self.map={'ask':{},'copilot':{}}; self.slot_id=[None]*4; self.notes=[]; self.cur_note=None; self._active={'ask':True,'copilot':True}; self.profiles={}; self._pending=[]; self._ready={}
        root=QVBoxLayout(self); root.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); root.setSpacing(3)
        top=QHBoxLayout(); self.ask_btn=btn('Ask DELL',78,bg='#e8f8d8'); self.copilot_btn=btn('Copilot',78,bg='#dbeafe'); self.reload=btn('AI更新',62); self.clear=btn('入力クリア',76,bg=RED)
        for w in (self.ask_btn,self.copilot_btn,self.reload,self.clear): top.addWidget(w)
        top.addStretch(); root.addLayout(top)
        self.split=QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal); self.split.setChildrenCollapsible(False); root.addWidget(self.split,1)
        self.panes={}; self.tabs={}
        for key,title in [('ask','ASK DELL'),('copilot','Copilot')]:
            pane=QWidget(); vl=QVBoxLayout(pane); vl.setContentsMargins(1,1,1,1); vl.setSpacing(2)
            hd=QHBoxLayout(); lab=QLabel(title); lab.setStyleSheet('font-weight:700;'); close=btn('×',24,bg='#fee2e2',h=22)
            hd.addWidget(lab); hd.addStretch(); hd.addWidget(close); vl.addLayout(hd)
            tabs=QTabWidget(); tabs.setTabBar(AskColorTabBar()); vl.addWidget(tabs,1)
            self.split.addWidget(pane); self.panes[key]=pane; self.tabs[key]=tabs
            close.clicked.connect(lambda _,k=key:self.set_pane_visible(k,False))
        self.split.setSizes([1,1])
        if WEB:
            # Ask DELL / Copilot / Outlook系のSSO Cookieを可能な範囲で共有し、再認証要求を減らす。
            prof=configure_web_profile(QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile(),'BusinessSharedSSOProfile')
            for key in ('ask','copilot'):
                self.profiles[key]=prof
        self.ask_btn.clicked.connect(lambda:self.set_pane_visible('ask',True)); self.copilot_btn.clicked.connect(lambda:self.set_pane_visible('copilot',True))
        self.reload.clicked.connect(lambda:[self.reload_current(k) for k in self.active_keys()])
        self.clear.clicked.connect(lambda:[self.inject_current(k,'',False) for k in self.active_keys()])
    def active_keys(self): return [k for k,v in self._active.items() if v]
    def set_pane_visible(self,key,visible):
        self._active[key]=bool(visible); self.panes[key].setVisible(visible)
        if not self.active_keys():
            other='copilot' if key=='ask' else 'ask'; self._active[other]=True; self.panes[other].setVisible(True)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda:self.split.setSizes([1 if self._active.get('ask') else 0,1 if self._active.get('copilot') else 0]))
    def _url_for(self,key): return ASK if key=='ask' else COPILOT
    def _view(self,key,n):
        if WEB:
            v=QWebEngineView(); v.setPage(Page(self.profiles.get(key),None,v)); v.setZoomFactor(.72); v.setUrl(QUrl(self._url_for(key)))
            nid=n.get('id',''); self._ready[(key,nid)]=False; v.loadFinished.connect(lambda ok,k=key,id=nid:self.flush_pending(k,id) if ok else None)
            return v
        return QLabel('WebEngineなし')
    def slot(self,n): return n['fixed_index'] if is_fixed(n) else None
    def ensure_note(self,n):
        if not isinstance(n,dict): return
        nid=n['id']; self.notes=[x for x in self.notes if x.get('id')!=nid]+[n]
        s=self.slot(n)
        if s is not None: self.slot_id[s]=nid
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            tabs=self.tabs[key]
            if nid not in self.map[key]:
                v=self._view(key,n); self.map[key][nid]=v
                pos=s if s is not None and s<=tabs.count() else tabs.count(); tabs.insertTab(pos,v,ntitle(n))
            else:
                i=tabs.indexOf(self.map[key][nid])
                if i>=0: tabs.setTabText(i,ntitle(n))
    def switch_note(self,n):
        self.cur_note=n; self.ensure_note(n); nid=n.get('id')
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            v=self.map[key].get(nid); i=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
            if i>=0: self.tabs[key].setCurrentIndex(i)
    def delete_note(self,nid):
        self._pending=[x for x in self._pending if x[1]!=nid]
        self.notes=[n for n in self.notes if n.get('id')!=nid]
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            self._ready.pop((key,nid),None)
            v=self.map[key].pop(nid,None)
            if v:
                i=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
                if i>=0: self.tabs[key].removeTab(i)
                v.deleteLater()
        for i,x in enumerate(self.slot_id):
            if x==nid: self.slot_id[i]=None
        if self.cur_note and self.cur_note.get('id')==nid: self.cur_note=None
    def clear_note(self,nid):
        self._pending=[x for x in self._pending if x[1]!=nid]
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            v=self.map[key].get(nid)
            if WEB and v is not None and hasattr(v,'setUrl'):
                self._ready[(key,nid)]=False
                try: v.setUrl(QUrl(self._url_for(key)))
                except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in AskTab.clear_note", exc_info=True)
    def reset_fixed_slot(self,slot,old_id,new_note): self.delete_note(old_id); self.ensure_note(new_note)
    def sync_notes(self,notes,current_index=0):
        notes=list(notes or []); valid={n.get('id') for n in notes if isinstance(n,dict)}
        stale=(set(self.map.get('ask',{}))|set(self.map.get('copilot',{})))-valid
        for nid in list(stale): self.delete_note(nid)
        self.notes=[]; self.slot_id=[None]*4
        for n in notes: self.ensure_note(n)
        if notes:
            current_index=max(0,min(int(current_index),len(notes)-1)); self.switch_note(notes[current_index])
    def bind_memo(self,memo): self.sync_notes(memo.notes,memo.idx)
    def update_fixed_tag(self,i,tag):
        try:
            if i<0 or i>3: return
            nid=self.slot_id[i] or next((n.get('id') for n in self.notes if n.get('fixed_index')==i),None)
            if not nid: return
            n=next((x for x in self.notes if x.get('id')==nid),None)
            if not n: return
            n['tag']=tag or ''; n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i]; self.slot_id[i]=nid
            for key in ('ask','copilot'):
                v=self.map[key].get(nid)
                if v is None:
                    self.ensure_note(n); v=self.map[key].get(nid)
                idx=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
                if idx>=0: self.tabs[key].setTabText(idx,ntitle(n))
        except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in AskTab.update_fixed_tag", exc_info=True)
    def current_view(self,key):
        if self.cur_note: return self.map[key].get(self.cur_note.get('id'))
        return self.tabs[key].currentWidget()
    def reload_current(self,key):
        v=self.current_view(key)
        if WEB and hasattr(v,'setUrl'):
            nid=self.cur_note.get('id') if self.cur_note else ''; self._ready[(key,nid)]=False; v.setUrl(QUrl(self._url_for(key)))
    def send_to_note(self,n,text,enter=True):
        self.switch_note(n)
        for key in self.active_keys(): self.inject_current(key,text,enter)
    def flush_pending(self,key,nid):
        self._ready[(key,nid)]=True
        pending=[x for x in self._pending if x[0]==key and x[1]==nid]; self._pending=[x for x in self._pending if not (x[0]==key and x[1]==nid)]
        for _,_,txt,enter in pending: self.inject_current(key,txt,enter)
    def inject_current(self,key,text,enter=False):
        v=self.current_view(key); nid=self.cur_note.get('id') if self.cur_note else ''
        if not (WEB and hasattr(v,'page')):
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text); return
        if not self._ready.get((key,nid),False):
            self._pending.append((key,nid,text,enter)); return
        js="""
(function(txt,submitNow){let areas=[...document.querySelectorAll('textarea, div[contenteditable="true"], [role="textbox"], input[type="text"]')];let el=areas.find(x=>x.offsetParent!==null)||areas[0];if(!el){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);}catch(e){} return 'clipboard';}el.focus();if(el.isContentEditable){el.textContent=txt; el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:txt}));}else{el.value=txt; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}if(submitNow){setTimeout(function(){let b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"]')].find(x=>!x.disabled && !/true/i.test(String(x.getAttribute('aria-disabled'))) && /send|送信|submit|arrow|paper/i.test((x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+' '+(x.title||'')+' '+(x.innerText||''))); if(b)b.click();},250);} return 'ok';})(%s,%s);
"""%(json.dumps(text,ensure_ascii=False),'true' if enter else 'false')
        try: v.page().runJavaScript(js)
        except Exception: QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
    def clear_input(self):
        for key in self.active_keys(): self.inject_current(key,'',False)


def parse_lkb_article_text(t):
    plain=strip_html(t or '')
    compact=re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', plain).strip()
    title_match=re.search(r'(?is)Knowledge\s+Article\s*(.+?)\s*Article\s+Record\s+Type\b',compact)
    number_match=re.search(r'(?is)Article\s+Number\s*[:：#＃]?\s*(\d{6,})\b',compact)
    title=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',title_match.group(1)).strip() if title_match else ''
    num=number_match.group(1) if number_match else ''
    if title and num:return f'{title} LKB#{num}'
    return ''

class TagPasteLineEdit(QLineEdit):
    full_text_pasted=Signal(str)
    def paste_full(self):
        text=QApplication.clipboard().text()
        if text:self.full_text_pasted.emit(text);return True
        return False
    def keyPressEvent(self,event):
        if event.matches(QKeySequence.StandardKey.Paste) and self.paste_full():event.accept();return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)
    def dropEvent(self,event):
        text=event.mimeData().text()
        if text:self.full_text_pasted.emit(text);event.acceptProposedAction();return
        super().dropEvent(event)
    def contextMenuEvent(self,event):
        menu=QMenu(self);menu.addAction('切り取り',self.cut);menu.addAction('コピー',self.copy);menu.addAction('貼り付け',self.paste_full);menu.addSeparator();menu.addAction('すべて選択',self.selectAll);menu.exec(event.globalPos())

class MemoCard(QWidget):
    raw_changed=Signal(str); clear_clicked=Signal(); selected=Signal()
    def __init__(self,n):
        super().__init__(); self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground,True); self.setFixedHeight(48); self._active=False; self._base_index=tag_color_index(n)%4; self._base_bg=TAG_TAB_COLORS[self._base_index]
        lay=QHBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(2,1,2,1); lay.setSpacing(2)
        self.input=TagPasteLineEdit(); self.input.setFixedHeight(42); self.input.setText(str(tag_display_text(n) or n.get('tag') or '')); self.input.setPlaceholderText('TAG')
        self.input.setFrame(False); self.input.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.IBeamCursor); self.input.setMaxLength(10)
        self.x=QPushButton('×'); self.x.setFixedSize(16,16); self.x.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._x_style='font-size:7pt;padding:0;border:0px;background:transparent;color:#991b1b;font-weight:700;'
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
        lay.addWidget(self.input,1); lay.addWidget(self.x,0,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self.x.clicked.connect(lambda _checked=False:self.clear_clicked.emit())
        _orig_x_press=self.x.mousePressEvent; _orig_x_release=self.x.mouseReleaseEvent
        def _x_press(e,orig=_orig_x_press):
            e.accept(); orig(e)
        def _x_release(e,orig=_orig_x_release):
            e.accept(); orig(e)
        self.x.mousePressEvent=_x_press; self.x.mouseReleaseEvent=_x_release
        self.input.textChanged.connect(lambda:self.raw_changed.emit(self.input.text())); self.input.full_text_pasted.connect(lambda text:self.raw_changed.emit(str(text or '')))
        _orig_mouse_press=self.input.mousePressEvent
        def _select_then_edit(e,orig=_orig_mouse_press,s=self):
            s.selected.emit(); orig(e)
        self.input.mousePressEvent=_select_then_edit
        self.set_active(False)
    def set_active(self,active):
        self._active=bool(active)
        # 選択時もTAG①～④の元色は入力欄に保持し、カード背景だけ濃い青にする。
        card_bg=SELECTED_BLUE if self._active else self._base_bg
        card_border='#082f6f' if self._active else '#6b7280'
        self.setStyleSheet('MemoCard{background:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:3px;color:#111827;}' % (card_bg,card_border))
        self.input.setStyleSheet('QLineEdit{font-size:9pt;padding:2px 5px;color:#111827;background:%s;border:0px;} QLineEdit::selection{background:#1d4ed8;color:#ffffff;}' % self._base_bg)
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
    def mousePressEvent(self,e):
        self.selected.emit(); self.input.setFocus(); super().mousePressEvent(e)
    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self,e): self.selected.emit(); self.input.setFocus(); self.input.selectAll()

class TemplateMemoCard(QWidget):
    selected=Signal(str); rename_requested=Signal(str); delete_requested=Signal(str); drag_requested=Signal(str)
    def __init__(self,data,active=False):
        super().__init__(); self._id=str(data.get('id') or ''); self._press_pos=None; self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground,True); self.setFixedHeight(25); self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        lay=QHBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(4,1,2,1); lay.setSpacing(2)
        self.label=QLabel(data.get('name') or 'メモ帳'); self.label.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents,True)
        self.x=QPushButton('×'); self.x.setFixedSize(16,16); self.x.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor); self.x.setStyleSheet('font-size:7pt;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#991b1b;font-weight:700;')
        lay.addWidget(self.label,1); lay.addWidget(self.x); self.x.clicked.connect(lambda:self.delete_requested.emit(self._id)); self.set_active(active)
    def set_active(self,active):
        bg=SELECTED_BLUE if active else '#ffffff'; fg='#ffffff' if active else '#111827'; border='#082f6f' if active else '#9ca3af'
        self.setStyleSheet('TemplateMemoCard{background:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:3px;}'%(bg,border)); self.label.setStyleSheet('font-size:8pt;color:%s;background:transparent;'%fg)
    def mousePressEvent(self,e):
        if e.button()==Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton: self._press_pos=e.position().toPoint()
        self.selected.emit(self._id); super().mousePressEvent(e)
    def mouseMoveEvent(self,e):
        if self._press_pos is not None and (e.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            if (e.position().toPoint()-self._press_pos).manhattanLength()>=QApplication.startDragDistance():
                self._press_pos=None; self.drag_requested.emit(self._id); e.accept(); return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)
    def mouseReleaseEvent(self,e): self._press_pos=None; super().mouseReleaseEvent(e)
    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self,e): self.rename_requested.emit(self._id); super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(e)

class TemplateMemoList(QListWidget):
    move_requested=Signal(str,int); MIME='application/x-l2-template-id'
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.setDragDropMode(QAbstractItemView.DragDropMode.DropOnly); self.setDefaultDropAction(Qt.DropAction.MoveAction); self.setAcceptDrops(True); self.setDropIndicatorShown(True); self.setSpacing(2); self.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.setStyleSheet('QListWidget{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;} QListWidget::item{background:transparent;border:0;} QListWidget::item:selected{background:transparent;border:0;}')
    def start_drag(self,tid):
        if not tid: return
        mime=QMimeData(); mime.setData(self.MIME,str(tid).encode('utf-8')); drag=QDrag(self); drag.setMimeData(mime); drag.exec(Qt.DropAction.MoveAction)
    def dragEnterEvent(self,e):
        if e.mimeData().hasFormat(self.MIME): e.acceptProposedAction()
        else: super().dragEnterEvent(e)
    def dragMoveEvent(self,e):
        if e.mimeData().hasFormat(self.MIME): e.acceptProposedAction()
        else: super().dragMoveEvent(e)
    def dropEvent(self,e):
        if not e.mimeData().hasFormat(self.MIME): super().dropEvent(e); return
        try: tid=bytes(e.mimeData().data(self.MIME)).decode('utf-8')
        except Exception: e.ignore(); return
        pos=e.position().toPoint(); row=self.indexAt(pos).row()
        if row<0: row=self.count()
        elif pos.y()>self.visualItemRect(self.item(row)).center().y(): row+=1
        self.move_requested.emit(tid,row); e.acceptProposedAction()

class PromptListItemWidget(QWidget):
    delete_requested=Signal(str);selected=Signal();edit_requested=Signal(str)
    def __init__(self,name,parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent);self.name=name
        lay=QHBoxLayout(self);lay.setContentsMargins(4,1,2,1);lay.setSpacing(3)
        self.label=QLabel(name);self.label.setToolTip(name);self.label.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents,True);lay.addWidget(self.label,1)
        self.x=QPushButton('×');self.x.setFixedSize(18,18);self.x.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor);self.x.setToolTip('このプロンプトを削除')
        self.x.setStyleSheet('QPushButton{border:0;background:transparent;color:#b91c1c;font-weight:700;}QPushButton:hover{background:#fee2e2;border-radius:4px;}')
        lay.addWidget(self.x,0);self.x.clicked.connect(lambda:self.delete_requested.emit(self.name))
    def mousePressEvent(self,e):
        if e.button()==Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:self.selected.emit()
        super().mousePressEvent(e)
    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self,e):
        if e.button()==Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:self.selected.emit();self.edit_requested.emit(self.name)
        super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(e)

                savej(MEMO.with_name('memos_body_backup.json'),{n.get('id'):str(n.get('content','') or n.get('body','') or '') for n in self.notes if isinstance(n,dict) and n.get('id')});self._content_dirty=False

    def body_changed(self):

    def highlight_memo_search(self):
        text=self.memoFind.text() if hasattr(self,'memoFind') else ''
        selections=[]
        if text:
            cursor=QTextCursor(self.edit.document());fmt=QTextCharFormat();fmt.setBackground(QColor('#fff59d'));fmt.setForeground(QColor('#111827'))
            while True:
                cursor=self.edit.document().find(text,cursor)
                if cursor.isNull():break
                selection=QTextEdit.ExtraSelection();selection.cursor=cursor;selection.format=fmt;selections.append(selection)
        self.edit.setExtraSelections(selections)
    def move_memo_search(self,backward=False):
        text=self.memoFind.text() if hasattr(self,'memoFind') else ''
        if not text:return
        flags=QTextDocument.FindFlag.FindBackward if backward else QTextDocument.FindFlag(0)
        if not self.edit.find(text,flags):
            cursor=QTextCursor(self.edit.document());cursor.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End if backward else QTextCursor.MoveOperation.Start);self.edit.setTextCursor(cursor);self.edit.find(text,flags)

            self.move_memo_search(bool(event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier));return True
        return super().eventFilter(obj,event)

    def clear_or_delete(self,nid):
        row=next((i for i,n in enumerate(self.notes) if n.get('id')==nid),-1)
        if row<0: return
        was_current=(row==self.idx); n=self.notes[row]; fixed=is_fixed(n)
        if fixed:
            slot=n.get('fixed_index',row); self._allow_blank_content_once=True; n['raw']=''; n['body']=''; n['content']=''; n['tag']=''; n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[slot]
            try:
                if self.ask:
                    self.ask.update_fixed_tag(slot,'') if hasattr(self.ask,'update_fixed_tag') else None
                    self.ask.clear_note(nid) if hasattr(self.ask,'clear_note') else None
            except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.clear_or_delete", exc_info=True)
            self.sync_tag_to_dell(slot,'')
        else:
            self.notes.pop(row)
            if row<self.idx: self.idx-=1
            elif row==self.idx: self.idx=min(row,len(self.notes)-1)
            try:
                if self.ask and hasattr(self.ask,'delete_note'): self.ask.delete_note(nid)
                elif self.ask and hasattr(self.ask,'delete_tab'): self.ask.delete_tab(nid)
            except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.clear_or_delete", exc_info=True)
            try: self.dell.delete_note(nid) if self.dell and hasattr(self.dell,'delete_note') else None
            except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.clear_or_delete", exc_info=True)
        if was_current and hasattr(self,'edit'):
            self.edit.blockSignals(True); self.edit.clear(); self.edit.blockSignals(False); self.sub.clear(); self.mx.clear()
        self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); self.update_outputs(); self.save(); self.sync_all_tags_to_dell()
        try:
            if self.ask and hasattr(self.ask,'sync_notes'): self.ask.sync_notes(self.notes,self.idx)
        except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.clear_or_delete", exc_info=True)
    def related_changed(self,nid,raw):

            if n.get('id')==nid:
                if i>=4:return
                # 入力途中でも文字を消さず、そのまま即時保存する。リスト再生成は行わない。
                n['raw']=str(raw or '');info=memo_input_info(n['raw']+'\n'+str(n.get('content','') or ''));n['tag']=(info.get('tag') or normalize_tag_text(n['raw']) or '').strip().upper();n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i]
                try:

                    if card and hasattr(card,'input') and card.input.text()!=n.get('tag',''):
                        card.input.blockSignals(True);card.input.setText(n.get('tag',''));card.input.blockSignals(False)
                except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.related_changed", exc_info=True)
                if i==self.idx:self.update_outputs()
                try:self.ask.update_fixed_tag(i,n.get('tag','')) if self.ask and hasattr(self.ask,'update_fixed_tag') else None
                except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.related_changed", exc_info=True)
                self.sync_tag_to_dell(i,n.get('tag',''))
                try:
                    [fm.refresh_from_source(force=True) for fm in QApplication.allWidgets() if isinstance(fm,FloatingSyncedMemo) and getattr(fm,'linked_mode',False)]
                except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.related_changed", exc_info=True)
                self.save();break

    def sync_tag_to_dell(self,i,tag):
        tag=(memo_input_info(tag or '').get('tag') or normalize_tag_text(tag or '') or '').strip().upper()
        if i<0 or i>3:return
        targets=[]
        direct=getattr(self,'dell',None)
        if direct:targets.append(direct)
        try:targets.extend(w for w in QApplication.allWidgets() if hasattr(w,'tag_boxes') or hasattr(w,'update_fixed_tag') or hasattr(w,'set_tag_for_group'))
        except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.sync_tag_to_dell", exc_info=True)
        seen=set()
        for w in targets:
            if id(w) in seen:continue
            seen.add(id(w))
            try:w.update_fixed_tag(i,tag)
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.sync_tag_to_dell", exc_info=True)
            try:w.set_tag_for_group(i,tag)
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.sync_tag_to_dell", exc_info=True)
            try:
                boxes=getattr(w,'tag_boxes',[])
                if 0<=i<len(boxes) and boxes[i].text()!=tag:boxes[i].setText(tag or '')
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.sync_tag_to_dell", exc_info=True)
    def save_prompts_safely(self):
        # Write a complete snapshot atomically so a partial write cannot overwrite prompt contents.
        try:
            snapshot={str(k):str(v) for k,v in self.prompts.items()}
            tmp=PR.with_suffix(PR.suffix+'.tmp')
            tmp.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
            os.replace(str(tmp),str(PR))
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self,APP,'プロンプトを保存できませんでした。\n\n'+repr(e))
    def refresh_prompt_list(self,select_name=None):
        if getattr(self,'_prompt_refreshing',False):return
        self._prompt_refreshing=True
        try:
            current=select_name or (self.current_prompt() if self.plist.count() else '')
            self.plist.clear()
            for name in self.prompts.keys():
                item=QListWidgetItem();item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole,name);item.setSizeHint(QSize(120,24));self.plist.addItem(item)
                widget=PromptListItemWidget(name,self.plist);widget.delete_requested.connect(self.delete_prompt);widget.selected.connect(lambda item=item:self.plist.setCurrentItem(item));widget.edit_requested.connect(self.edit_prompt);self.plist.setItemWidget(item,widget)
                if name==current:self.plist.setCurrentItem(item)
            if self.plist.currentRow()<0 and self.plist.count():self.plist.setCurrentRow(0)
        finally:self._prompt_refreshing=False
    def persist_prompt_order(self):
        if getattr(self,'_prompt_refreshing',False):return
        selected=self.current_prompt();names=[]
        for i in range(self.plist.count()):
            name=self.plist.item(i).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            if name in self.prompts and name not in names:names.append(name)
        if len(names)!=len(self.prompts):return
        old=dict(self.prompts);self.prompts={name:old[name] for name in names}
        self.save_prompts_safely();self.refresh_prompt_list(selected)
    def open_prompt_menu(self,pos):
        item=self.plist.itemAt(pos) or self.plist.currentItem();name=(item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) if item else '') or ''
        menu=QMenu(self)
        if name:
            menu.addAction('現在のプロンプトを表示・変更',lambda:self.edit_prompt(name))
            menu.addSeparator();menu.addAction('削除',lambda:self.delete_prompt(name))
        menu.addAction('プロンプトを追加',self.add_prompt)
        menu.exec(self.plist.viewport().mapToGlobal(pos))
    def prompt_editor(self,title,name='',text=''):
        dlg=QDialog(self);dlg.setWindowTitle(title);dlg.resize(620,430);lay=QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        lay.addWidget(QLabel('プロンプト名'));name_edit=QLineEdit(name);lay.addWidget(name_edit)
        lay.addWidget(QLabel('プロンプト内容'));body=QPlainTextEdit();body.setPlainText(text);lay.addWidget(body,1)
        buttons=QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save|QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel);buttons.accepted.connect(dlg.accept);buttons.rejected.connect(dlg.reject);lay.addWidget(buttons)
        if dlg.exec()!=QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:return None
        return name_edit.text().strip(),body.toPlainText()
    def edit_prompt(self,name):
        if name not in self.prompts:return
        original_text=self.prompts[name]
        result=self.prompt_editor('現在のプロンプトを表示・変更',name,original_text)
        if result is None:return
        new_name,text=result
        if not new_name:QMessageBox.warning(self,APP,'プロンプト名を入力してください。');return
        if new_name!=name and new_name in self.prompts:QMessageBox.warning(self,APP,'同じ名前のプロンプトがあります。');return
        updated={}
        for key,value in self.prompts.items():updated[new_name if key==name else key]=text if key==name else value
        self.prompts=updated;self.save_prompts_safely();self.refresh_prompt_list(new_name)
    def add_prompt(self):
        result=self.prompt_editor('プロンプトを追加','','')
        if result is None:return
        name,text=result
        if not name:QMessageBox.warning(self,APP,'プロンプト名を入力してください。');return
        if name in self.prompts:QMessageBox.warning(self,APP,'同じ名前のプロンプトがあります。');return
        # Append only the new entry; existing prompt text is never reconstructed or overwritten.
        self.prompts[name]=text;self.save_prompts_safely();self.refresh_prompt_list(name)
    def delete_prompt(self,name):
        if name not in self.prompts:return
        answer=QMessageBox.question(self,'プロンプト削除',f'「{name}」を削除してよいですか？',QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes|QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,QMessageBox.StandardButton.No)
        if answer!=QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:return
        self.prompts.pop(name,None);self.save_prompts_safely();self.refresh_prompt_list()
    def current_prompt(self):
        it=self.plist.currentItem() or self.plist.item(0); return ((it.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) if it else '') or '🔎 汎用分析')
    def copy_current_prompt(self):
        extracted=self.mx.toPlainText().strip();body=self.edit.toPlainText();raw=((extracted+'\n') if extracted else '')+body;tag=self.notes[self.idx].get('tag','') if self.notes and 0<=self.idx<len(self.notes) else ''
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(build_prompt(self.current_prompt(),raw,self.prompts,tag))
    def to_ask(self,send=True):
        extracted=self.mx.toPlainText().strip();body=self.edit.toPlainText();raw=((extracted+'\n') if extracted else '')+body;tag=self.notes[self.idx].get('tag','') if self.notes and 0<=self.idx<len(self.notes) else '';txt=build_prompt(self.current_prompt(),raw,self.prompts,tag)
        delivered=False
        if self.ask:
            try:
                if hasattr(self.ask,'switch_note') and self.notes: self.ask.switch_note(self.notes[self.idx])
                if hasattr(self.ask,'active_keys'):
                    for key in self.ask.active_keys(): self.ask.inject_current(key,txt,send)
                    delivered=True
                elif hasattr(self.ask,'inject_current'):
                    try: self.ask.inject_current(self.notes[self.idx],txt,send); delivered=True
                    except TypeError: self.ask.inject_current(txt,send); delivered=True
            except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in MemoPanel.to_ask", exc_info=True)
        if not delivered: QApplication.clipboard().setText(txt)

class OneNoteLaunchOnlyTab(QWidget):
    def __init__(self,parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        lay=QVBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12)
        self.open_btn=btn('OneNoteを起動',140,bg='#dbeafe')
        lay.addWidget(self.open_btn,0,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft); lay.addStretch()
        self.open_btn.clicked.connect(self.launch)
    def launch(self):
        # Activate and maximize an already-open OneNote window before starting a new instance.
        if os.name=='nt':
            try:
                import ctypes
                u=ctypes.windll.user32;hits=[]
                CB=ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p)
                def cb(hwnd,_):
                    if not u.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):return True
                    n=u.GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd)
                    if n:
                        buf=ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(n+1);u.GetWindowTextW(hwnd,buf,n+1)
                        title=buf.value.lower()
                        if 'onenote' in title or 'one note' in title:hits.append(hwnd)
                    return True
                u.EnumWindows(CB(cb),0)
                if hits:
                    hwnd=hits[0];u.ShowWindow(hwnd,9);u.ShowWindow(hwnd,3);u.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd);return
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in OneNoteLaunchOnlyTab.launch", exc_info=True)
        # Do not call onenote: because Windows displays a protocol-owner error when the URI is unavailable.
        paths=[
            Path(os.environ.get('ProgramFiles','C:/Program Files'))/'Microsoft Office'/'root'/'Office16'/'ONENOTE.EXE',
            Path(os.environ.get('ProgramFiles(x86)','C:/Program Files (x86)'))/'Microsoft Office'/'root'/'Office16'/'ONENOTE.EXE'
        ]
        for p in paths:
            try:
                if p.exists():subprocess.Popen([str(p)],creationflags=0x08000000);return
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in OneNoteLaunchOnlyTab.launch", exc_info=True)
        try:
            ok=QProcess.startDetached('explorer.exe',[r'shell:AppsFolder\Microsoft.Office.OneNote_8wekyb3d8bbwe!microsoft.onenoteim'])
            if ok:return
        except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in OneNoteLaunchOnlyTab.launch", exc_info=True)
        QMessageBox.information(self,APP,'OneNoteアプリが見つかりません。OneNoteタブはそのまま使用できます。')
    def launch_onenote(self): self.launch()

def apply_right_browser_zoom_90(widget):
    try:
        views=[]
        if WEB and isinstance(widget,QWebEngineView):views.append(widget)
        if WEB:views.extend(widget.findChildren(QWebEngineView))
        for view in views:
            if view.property('_right_zoom_90_done'):continue
            view.setZoomFactor(max(0.25,view.zoomFactor()*0.9));view.setProperty('_right_zoom_90_done',True)
    except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in apply_right_browser_zoom_90", exc_info=True)

class LazyToolTab(QWidget):
    def __init__(self,title,clsname,parent_tools=None):
        super().__init__(parent_tools); self.title=title; self.clsname=clsname; self.parent_tools=parent_tools; self.loaded=False; self.real=None
        self._lay=QVBoxLayout(self); self._lay.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12); self._label=QLabel(f'{title} はタブ選択時に読み込みます。'); self._label.setWordWrap(True); self._lay.addWidget(self._label); self._lay.addStretch()
    def load(self):
        if self.loaded: return self.real
        self.loaded=True
        try:
            cls=eclass(self.clsname); w=cls(self) if self.clsname not in ('ImageCompareTab','BrowserTab','MemoTab') else cls()
            if hasattr(w,'ensure_initialized'): QTimer.singleShot(250,w.ensure_initialized)
        except Exception as e: w=etab(self.title,e)
        while self._lay.count():
            it=self._lay.takeAt(0); old=it.widget(); old.deleteLater() if old else None
        self._lay.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); self._lay.addWidget(w); self.real=w
        if self.title=='DELLサイトなど':
            try:
                for panel in QApplication.allWidgets():
                    if isinstance(panel,MemoPanel):panel.dell=w;panel.sync_all_tags_to_dell()
            except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in LazyToolTab.load", exc_info=True)
        QTimer.singleShot(500,lambda:apply_right_browser_zoom_90(w));handler=getattr(self.parent_tools,'lazy_tab_loaded_handler',None);QTimer.singleShot(0,handler) if callable(handler) else None
        return w

def attach_dell(panel):

                panel.tag_boxes[i].setText(tag or '')

def clamp_to_nearest_screen(widget):

        geo=widget.geometry();screen=QApplication.screenAt(geo.center()) or QApplication.primaryScreen()
        if not screen:return
        a=screen.availableGeometry();w=min(geo.width(),a.width());h=min(geo.height(),a.height());x=max(a.x(),min(geo.x(),a.right()-w+1));y=max(a.y(),min(geo.y(),a.bottom()-h+1));widget.setGeometry(x,y,w,h)
    except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in clamp_to_nearest_screen", exc_info=True)

    def _fixed_index_from_note(self,note):
        try:
            i=note.get('fixed_index') if isinstance(note,dict) else None
            return i if i in (0,1,2,3) else None
        except Exception:return None
    def install_tag_selection_sync(self):
        # 右側のAsk DELL/DELLサイト側から選ばれたTAGも左メモと簡易メモへ反映する。
        try:
            self.browser.memo.select_tag_group=self.select_tag_group
            dell_panels=[];note_panels=[]
            for w in QApplication.allWidgets():
                tabs=getattr(w,'web_tabs',None);groups=getattr(w,'group_tabs',None)
                if isinstance(tabs,QTabWidget) and isinstance(groups,list):dell_panels.append(w)
                notes=getattr(w,'notes',None);switch=getattr(w,'switch_note',None) or getattr(w,'switch',None)
                if isinstance(notes,list) and callable(switch):note_panels.append(w)
                if isinstance(tabs,QTabWidget) and isinstance(groups,list) and id(tabs) not in self._tag_selection_connections:
                    tabs.currentChanged.connect(lambda _i,p=w:self._right_dell_selection_changed(p));self._tag_selection_connections.add(id(tabs))
                for gi,box in enumerate(getattr(w,'tag_boxes',[])[:4]):

                        original_press=box.mousePressEvent
                        def synchronized_press(event,orig=original_press,i=gi,p=w):
                            self.select_tag_group(i,p);orig(event)
                        box.mousePressEvent=synchronized_press;self._tag_selection_connections.add(id(box))

                            tabs2.currentChanged.connect(lambda _i,p=w:self._right_ai_selection_changed(p));self._tag_selection_connections.add(id(tabs2))
                elif isinstance(tabsets,QTabWidget) and hasattr(w,'pages') and id(tabsets) not in self._tag_selection_connections:
                    tabsets.currentChanged.connect(lambda _i,p=w:self._right_ai_selection_changed(p));self._tag_selection_connections.add(id(tabsets))
            self._tag_dell_panels=list(dict.fromkeys(dell_panels));self._tag_note_panels=list(dict.fromkeys(note_panels))
        except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in Controller.install_tag_selection_sync", exc_info=True)
        QTimer.singleShot(10000,self.install_tag_selection_sync)
    def _right_dell_selection_changed(self,panel):
        if self._tag_select_syncing:return
        try:
            current=panel.web_tabs.currentWidget()
            for i,group in enumerate(panel.group_tabs[:4]):
                if current in group.values():self.select_tag_group(i,panel);return
        except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in Controller._right_dell_selection_changed", exc_info=True)
    def _right_ai_selection_changed(self,panel):
        if self._tag_select_syncing:return
        try:
            i=panel.current_fixed_index() if callable(getattr(panel,'current_fixed_index',None)) else None
            if i is None:i=self._fixed_index_from_note(getattr(panel,'cur_note',None) or getattr(panel,'cur',None))
            if i is not None:self.select_tag_group(i,panel)
        except Exception:_logger.debug("silent exception in Controller._right_ai_selection_changed", exc_info=True)
    def select_tag_group(self,i,source=None):
        if self._tag_select_syncing or i not in (0,1,2,3):return

            memo=self.browser.memo

                memo.list.blockSignals(True);memo.list.setCurrentRow(i);memo.list.blockSignals(False);memo.idx=i;memo.apply()
            memo.update_left_card_styles()

                    if callable(refresh):refresh()
                    groups=getattr(w,'group_tabs',None);tabs=getattr(w,'web_tabs',None)
                    if isinstance(groups,list) and i<len(groups) and isinstance(tabs,QTabWidget):
                        current=tabs.currentWidget();key=next((k for g in groups for k,v in g.items() if v is current),None);target=groups[i].get(key) if key else None
                        if target is None:target=groups[i].get('drivers') or next(iter(groups[i].values()),None)
                        if target is not None and tabs.currentWidget() is not target:tabs.setCurrentWidget(target)
                except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in Controller.select_tag_group", exc_info=True)
            return
        self._selected_tag_group=i
        self._tag_select_syncing=True
        try:
            memo=self.browser.memo
            if memo.idx!=i:
                memo.list.blockSignals(True);memo.list.setCurrentRow(i);memo.list.blockSignals(False);memo.idx=i;memo.apply();memo.update_left_card_styles()
            for w in self._tag_dell_panels:
                groups=getattr(w,'group_tabs',None);tabs=getattr(w,'web_tabs',None)
                if isinstance(groups,list) and i<len(groups) and isinstance(tabs,QTabWidget):
                    try:
                        w._active_dell_group_index=i
                        refresh=getattr(w,'_refresh_dell_tag_styles',None)
                        if callable(refresh):refresh()
                        select=getattr(w,'_select_dell_tag',None)
                        if callable(select):select(i)
                    except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in Controller.select_tag_group", exc_info=True)
                    try:
                        group=groups[i];tag=str(getattr(w,'tag_boxes',[])[i].text() if i<len(getattr(w,'tag_boxes',[])) else '').strip();loaded=getattr(w,'_controller_loaded_tag_values',{})
                        if loaded.get(i)!=tag:
                            if any(str(getattr(page,'url','')) in ('','about:blank') for page in group.values()):w.open_tag(i,show_warning=False) if tag else w.reset_group_to_initial_state(i)
                            loaded[i]=tag;w._controller_loaded_tag_values=loaded
                    except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in Controller.select_tag_group", exc_info=True)
                    current=tabs.currentWidget();key=next((k for g in groups for k,v in g.items() if v is current),None);target=groups[i].get(key) if key else None
                    if target is None:target=groups[i].get('drivers') or next(iter(groups[i].values()),None)
                    if target is not None and tabs.currentWidget() is not target:tabs.setCurrentWidget(target)
            for w in self._tag_note_panels:
                notes=getattr(w,'notes',None);switch=getattr(w,'switch_note',None) or getattr(w,'switch',None)
                if isinstance(notes,list) and callable(switch):
                    n=next((x for x in notes if self._fixed_index_from_note(x)==i),None)
                    if n is not None:
                        try:switch(n)
                        except Exception:_logger.warning("silent exception in Controller.select_tag_group", exc_info=True)
        finally:self._tag_select_syncing=False
    def _screen_layout_key(self):
        # 画面名・座標・解像度の組み合わせごとに、ウィンドウ座標を自動保存する。
        parts=[]
        for screen in QApplication.screens():
            g=screen.geometry(); parts.append('%s:%d,%d,%d,%d'%(screen.name(),g.x(),g.y(),g.width(),g.height()))
        return '|'.join(sorted(parts)) or 'default'
    def _valid_screen_rect(self,values):
        if not (isinstance(values,list) and len(values)==4):return None
        try:r=QRect(*[int(v) for v in values])
        except Exception:return None
        if r.width()<240 or r.height()<160:return None
        return r if any(screen.availableGeometry().intersects(r) for screen in QApplication.screens()) else None
    def _auto_coordinate_profile(self):
        profiles=self.s.get('auto_coordinate_profiles',{})
        return profiles.get(self._screen_layout_key(),{}) if isinstance(profiles,dict) else {}
    def geo(self):
        sg=QApplication.primaryScreen().availableGeometry() if QApplication.primaryScreen() else QRect(0,0,1600,900)
        profile=self._auto_coordinate_profile()
        bg=self._valid_screen_rect(profile.get('google_geo')) or self._valid_screen_rect(self.s.get('google_geo'))
        tg=self._valid_screen_rect(profile.get('business_tools_geo')) or self._valid_screen_rect(self.s.get('business_tools_geo'))
        if bg is None:bg=QRect(sg.x()+20,sg.y()+40,min(max(640,int(sg.width()*0.58)),max(640,sg.width()-40)),max(360,sg.height()-120))
        if tg is None:tg=QRect(sg.x()+max(20,sg.width()-min(max(520,int(sg.width()*0.40)),max(520,sg.width()-40))-20),sg.y()+40,min(max(520,int(sg.width()*0.40)),max(520,sg.width()-40)),max(360,sg.height()-120))
        self.browser.setGeometry(bg);self.tools.setGeometry(tg);clamp_to_nearest_screen(self.browser);clamp_to_nearest_screen(self.tools)
    def install_floating_memo(self):
        self.tools.floating_memo=None

        self.browser.show();clamp_to_nearest_screen(self.browser);self.tools.show();clamp_to_nearest_screen(self.tools)
        try:
            self.tools.floating_memo=None

        self.save(); perform_cleanup(); old_geo=self.tools.geometry(); old=self.tools; old.hide(); old.deleteLater(); self.tools=Tools(self.s); self.tools.restart_handler=self.restart_right_tools; self.tools.lazy_tab_loaded_handler=self.install_tag_selection_sync; self.tools.setGeometry(old_geo); ask=self.tools.tools.get('Ask DELL'); self.browser.memo.bind(ask,None); self.browser.memo.select_tag_group=self.select_tag_group; self._selected_tag_group=None; self._tag_dell_panels=[]; self._tag_note_panels=[]; self.install_floating_memo(); self.tools.show();clamp_to_nearest_screen(self.tools);QTimer.singleShot(600,self.install_tag_selection_sync)
        try: self.tools.floating_memo.show(); self.tools.floating_memo.raise_()
        except Exception: _logger.debug("silent exception in Controller.restart_right_tools", exc_info=True)
    def save(self):
        self.browser.save(self.s); self.tools.save_state(self.s)
        # 現在のモニター構成専用の座標だけを追加保存し、自宅・会社を自動で切り替える。
        profiles=self.s.get('auto_coordinate_profiles',{})
        if not isinstance(profiles,dict):profiles={}
        profile={
            'google_geo':[self.browser.x(),self.browser.y(),self.browser.width(),self.browser.height()],
            'business_tools_geo':[self.tools.x(),self.tools.y(),self.tools.width(),self.tools.height()]
        }
